problem:
$$
C=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & -2 \\ 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}]
$$

If $C=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $C$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{32}\cdot {u}_{22}?$
worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $C$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & -2 \\ 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & -2 \\ -4 & -6 & -7 \\ 0 & 3 & \frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & -2 \\ -4 & -6 & -7 \\ \,\,0\,\, & -\frac{1}{2} & -3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -\frac{1}{2} & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & -6 & -7 \\ 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{32}=-\frac{1}{2}$ and ${u}_{22}=-6,$ we get

$$
{l}_{32}\cdot {u}_{22}=(-\frac{1}{2})\cdot (-6)=3.
$$
